verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents its own permission controls. 'Advanced permissions' let admins control who can view or modify sensitive equity data, custom roles can be created (shown for certificate executors), and a secure data room shares diligence materials. Together these suggest invited third parties could get limited, non-admin access to parts of the equity data. Nothing shows delegated or programmatic access for outside firms such as law firms, HRIS vendors or wealth managers. missing for 10: scoped API tokens or OAuth delegated access, documented third-party or advisor roles, field- or entity-level scoping of equity data slices, and independent corroboration.
